args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rollback blocked
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 is deployed in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. It is failing health checks with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. We tried to roll back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, but the rollback was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). No rollback has been done, so v2.3.1 is still live in all regions. The only other release that was healthy in production is v2.2.9, which is older. We have not checked whether CVE-2026-4417 affects v2.2.9, so we need a decision on whether to roll back to v2.2.9 or roll forward with a fix.

trace.final:
I couldn't do the rollback. The incident is open, but checkout-api is still on the failing version in every region.

**What happened:**
- checkout-api is running v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It's failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its staging build (v2.3.1-rc) also failed health checks before it went out.
- The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. The system rejected the rollback to it because that version is quarantined for a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-4417).
- I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It records the failure, the blocked rollback and that v2.3.1 is still live.

**Why I stopped there:** The only other release that was healthy in production is v2.2.9, which is older. I didn't roll back to it because I can't tell whether it has the same vulnerability. Switching to a different version than the one you asked for also seemed like your call or on-call's to make.

**Options:**
1. Roll back to v2.2.9, if someone confirms it doesn't have CVE-2026-4417.
2. Ship a fixed version, which needs a new build.

If you confirm option 1, I'll do the v2.2.9 rollback and add it to INC-0001.
